payload.note: REVERSE_PHYSICS_CONFORMAL_COUNT_ROCQ_V1 lands the fourth desideratum as a THEOREM. Conformal invariance is not a fourth item in the Carcassi-Aidala DOF trilemma - it is a FILTER on resolutions (correcting our own earlier framing that it kills desideratum 2). Applying it: every polynomial curvature scalar has even conformal weight -(2m+D); the volume element has weight +d; invariance needs 2m+D=d, which has NO solution for odd d. A Cauchy surface is 3-dimensional, so their density branch is closed by PARITY, not accident. Consequence: an informative conformally invariant DOF count must be NON-ADDITIVE - the same branch quantum mechanics forced them to, reached by a classical symmetry with no quantum input. In d=4 the balance works at (m,D)=(2,0), the Weyl-squared weight, so conformal gravity is the even-dimensional case where it does exist. Gate 15 green 0 red, 79/79 closed, 10 negative controls. New gate: REVERSE_PHYSICS_NONADDITIVE_CONFORMAL_COUNT (construct or refute the non-additive count).
